thread:
sarah: Quick postmortem follow-up on the vendor/dependency outage this morning — cloud provider zone flapped + model-registry auth tokens expired. We need clear owners, short timelines, and a regular pattern review. Who's taking what?

mike: I can own vendor engagement + contract escalation (SLA/credits). I'll sync with cloud-support tomorrow and aim for a draft ask by Friday. @julia can you help with contractual language? :+1:

kevin: I'll take model-registry auth hardening and the runtime fallback logic. Plan: 1) token refresh automation, 2) transient auth retry with jitter, 3) cached artifact fallback. ETA 2w for rollout.

julia: Yep, will draft SLA language and a short amendment template. Aim to have a review copy for legal by Wed. Also need to know desired RTO/RPO targets from product/security.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4923 (vendor-sla-engagement) and INF-4924 (model-registry-auth-fallback).

ops-oncall: Added immediate mitigations to the runbook: vendor-fallback path + manual steps for rotating registry service keys. Link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/vendor-fallback (internal).

sarah: Concrete action list I want in the tracker now — please update INF tickets with status and estimated completion dates: 1) Vendor SLA ask (owner: mike) — target EOD Fri for initial ask, 2) Contract draft (owner: julia) — review Wed, 3) Registry auth automation (owner: kevin) — 2w, 4) Short-term fallback (owner: kevin/ops) — 48h hotfix, 5) Add monitoring & recurring RCA cadence (owner: sarah) — schedule by Mon.

mike: Will do. Also requesting we add an explicit fallback routing policy in the smart router: prefer regional replica -> cached artifact -> degraded model. Putting a simple policy in the tracker.

kevin: For the hotfix fallback I'll push a tiny config change to Dedicated runtime:

```yaml
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  order:
    - regional_replica
    - cached_model
    - degraded_small_model
  retry: 2
  backoff: exponential
```

kevin: That plus a short-lived cached artifact should let us survive provider auth blips while we fix token expiry.

julia: Legal note: when asking for SLA credits, we should quantify impact (tokens/sec * minutes) + revenue estimate. Can the SRE/product team help with a short impact calc?

sarah: @product and @sre — can you provide a short impact estimate by EOD? We need numbers for the SLA ask.

mike: Also flagged recurring pattern: similar vendor auth flaps in last 3 months (minor), model registry token rotations have tripped twice. Suggest monthly vendor-dependency review & a recurring test that simulates token expiry.

kevin: I'll add a synthetic job to our CI that rotates a test service account token every week and verifies registry access. If it fails, create alert to paging.

ops-oncall: We should add a runbook check: when vendor-zone is degraded, automatically switch routing policy to prefer cached_model. I added a checkbox in INF-4924.

sarah: Great. I'll create the action tracker sheet and link it in the INF tickets. Interim owners: mike/julia/kevin. Weekly status updates in #incidents on Mondays.

mike: Quick question — do we want legal to push for contractual right to run a cross-regional fallback test? That might help with proving resilience in prod.

julia: We can request the right in the SLA/annex, yes. I'll make it an optional clause and flag for sales/contract teams.

sarah: Final asks for this thread: please update your INF tickets with completion ETA, add any sub-tasks, and mark blockers. I'll follow up in tomorrow's all-hands for infra. :calendar:

kevin: Updated INF-4924 with sub-tasks for hotfix + automation + synthetic test.

mike: INF-4923 updated with vendor contact and initial ask draft attached.

infra-bot: INF-4923 status changed to "In progress" by mike.

sarah: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in the weekly incident review; if anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :eyes:

ops-oncall: Leaving this note for oncall: if you see model-registry 5xx spikes, run the fallback playbook first, then escalate to infra.

sarah: Thread summary pinned: owners (mike/julia/kevin), timelines (48h hotfix, 2w automation, Fri/Wed legal), recurring testing + monthly review. Update tickets by EOD.
